faqs.q: Where and how is the GOST female thread adapter used?
faqs.a: The GOST adapter with female thread puts a female pipe thread on one side of a GOST connection, so a GOST hose coupling can be tied to a threaded pipe nipple, valve or pump port. The other side carries the symmetric GOST head. This listing carries 3 part numbers, covering 2", 2-1/2" and 3".

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the GOST female thread adapter?
faqs.a: The GOST female thread adapter is listed in 2", 2-1/2" and 3", as 3 part numbers such as IH-GST-ADAPTER-FEMALE-200, IH-GST-ADAPTER-FEMALE-250 and IH-GST-ADAPTER-FEMALE-300. Quote the part number, or the size and connection you need, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the GOST female thread adapter?
faqs.a: Choose the adapter by GOST size, 2", 2-1/2" or 3", and by the pipe thread you are joining. A female thread suits a male nipple or valve outlet; if the fixed side is female, use the male thread adapter instead.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the GOST female thread adapter?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the GOST female thread adapter, so we do not quote one. The joint seals on an NBR gasket held in the coupling face, which makes the gasket and the hose the limiting parts. Give us your working pressure and medium through [our contact page](/contact) and we check it with the maker before you order.

faqs.q: What is the GOST female thread adapter made from?
faqs.a: The GOST female thread adapter is cast aluminium with an NBR gasket, and anodised treatment is available by request where the service is more corrosive than plain aluminium will tolerate. Cast aluminium keeps the large sizes light enough to handle by hand.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the GOST female thread adapter?
faqs.a: GOST is the Russian and CIS coupling pattern, and the listing names no ISO, EN or API standard and no certificates for the GOST female thread adapter. If your project needs a conformity statement or material test report, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue. See our [guide to GOST, Barcelona and GEKA couplings](/blog/gost-barcelona-and-geka-couplings) for how the patterns compare.

faqs.q: What does the GOST female thread adapter connect to?
faqs.a: The GOST end connects to any GOST coupling of the same size, and the female thread end takes a male pipe thread. See [the male thread adapter](/p/gost-adapter-x-male-thread) for the opposite gender and [the GOST coupling](/p/russian-gost-coupling) for the hose side.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the GOST female thread adapter?
faqs.a: On the GOST female thread adapter, inspect the NBR gasket at each make-up and keep spares with the assembly, because it is the wear part of the joint. Close the cam levers fully and check that the two faces sit flat. GOST is not interchangeable with cam and groove, Storz or Guillemin, so confirm the pattern before ordering.

faqs.q: Where is the GOST female thread adapter used?
faqs.a: This adapter ties GOST hose to fixed pipework, pump ports and tank outlets in fuel, oil and water transfer on equipment built to Russian standards. It is typical at truck, tanker and depot connections across the CIS.

faqs.a: The female thread adapter takes a male pipe nipple, while [the GOST male thread adapter](/p/gost-adapter-x-male-thread) carries a male thread to screw into a female port. Pick by the gender of the fixed connection; both are listed in 2", 2-1/2" and 3".
